_comment: Extraction config. Copy to _pipeline/config.json and fill in the DB credentials. Params only; the DB is a local read-only Odoo instance. Change threshold/window here to re-run on another dataset without touching code.

redaction._comment: Defense-in-depth policy for extract.py's assert_no_pii guard. po_context.sql/vendor_audit.sql already substitute a synthetic 'user_<id>' label for every real Odoo user name at the source, so no personal name should ever reach this pipeline's output. forbidden_patterns are regexes checked against the whole serialised object; identity_fields are the dotted/bracketed paths (see extract.py's walk_paths helper) that must, where present, hold a string matching identity_label_pattern.
